name: Slopper Studio 1.1 Experimental
notes: Seedance in full: keyframes, reference roles (the app writes which @Image is what, with a preview of the prompt sent), extend sequel/prequel, and 480p draft to 1080p final of the same take. Help text is now behind ? icons (hover to read). Video thumbnails and video info without ffmpeg. Workflows, tools, storyboards and upscaling are still in 1.0 Beta.
